name: folk
label: Folk
description: Folk is a CRM for building relationships at scale. Manage your contacts, companies, and relationships in one place.

token.label: API Key
token.description: Your Folk API key. You can view and manage your API keys in your workspace settings under the "API" section at https://app.folk.app/apps/contacts/network/settings/api-keys

getCompany.label: Get Company
getCompany.description: Retrieve detailed information about a company from your Folk workspace.

companyId.label: Company
companyId.description: Pick a company from your Folk workspace. Type to search by name.

create_group_object.label: Create Group Object (Deal)
create_group_object.description: Create an object, such as a deal, in a Folk group.

groupId.label: Group ID
groupId.description: ID of the group the objects live in (grp_...).

objectType.label: Object Type
objectType.description: Object type name as shown in the group, e.g. Deals.

name.label: Name
name.description: Object name, e.g. the deal title.

personIds.label: Person IDs
personIds.description: People in this group to link (per_...); Folk ignores records outside the group.

companyIds.label: Company IDs
companyIds.description: Companies in this group to link (com_...); Folk ignores records outside the group.

customFieldValues.label: Custom Field Values
customFieldValues.description: Object fields as {"Field Name": value}, e.g. {"Status": "Qualified", "Amount": 5000}. null clears a field. Get names from List Group Custom Fields with the object type.

idempotencyKey.label: Idempotency Key
idempotencyKey.description: Optional unique key (max 255 characters). If the same request is sent again with the same key, Folk returns the first result instead of creating a duplicate. Reuse the key only when retrying the same request.

get_company_ai.label: Get Company
get_company_ai.description: Get one Folk company by ID.

get_current_user.label: Get Current User
get_current_user.description: Get the Folk user who owns the API key.

get_note.label: Get Note
get_note.description: Get one Folk note by ID.

get_person_ai.label: Get Person
get_person_ai.description: Get one Folk person by ID.

update_group_object.label: Update Group Object (Deal)
update_group_object.description: Update an object, such as a deal, in a Folk group.

groupId.label: Group ID
groupId.description: ID of the group the objects live in (grp_...).

objectType.label: Object Type
objectType.description: Object type name as shown in the group, e.g. Deals.

objectId.label: Object ID
objectId.description: ID of the object to update (obj_...).

personIds.label: Person IDs
personIds.description: People in this group to link (per_...); Folk ignores records outside the group. Replaces the current links. Empty keeps them; to remove all, pick the list in Clear Fields.

companyIds.label: Company IDs
companyIds.description: Companies in this group to link (com_...); Folk ignores records outside the group. Replaces the current links. Empty keeps them; to remove all, pick the list in Clear Fields.

customFieldValues.label: Custom Field Values
customFieldValues.description: Object fields as {"Field Name": value}, e.g. {"Status": "Qualified", "Amount": 5000}. null clears a field. Get names from List Group Custom Fields with the object type.

clearFields.label: Clear Fields
clearFields.description: Links to remove. A list named here is emptied even if IDs are also given for it.

update_note.label: Update Note
update_note.description: Change the text or visibility of a Folk note.

noteId.label: Note ID
noteId.description: ID of the note to update.

content.label: Content
content.description: New note text (replaces the old text).

visibility.label: Visibility
visibility.description: public or private. Leave empty to keep the current visibility.
